title.text: SCB TGL Content Fragment Bulk Upload

intro.text: Create, update or delete offer-listing content fragments from an Excel workbook. Pick the folder, get a workbook, fill it in, upload it to DAM, then run it.

text.text: The folder that holds the offer-listing fragments, in its sub-folders offers, cards, categories, merchants, merchants/venues and offer-cta. The sample sheet, the report and the run all use this folder.
A DAM folder whose name is offer-listing, e.g. /content/dam/aemcloudproject/cfs/offer-listing. Not one of its sub-folders.

term.text: Why it is empty each time

text.text: There is no default, so you always choose on purpose and never change the wrong folder by mistake.

rootPath.emptyText: Click the folder icon and pick the folder named offer-listing
rootPath.name: rootPath

text.text: Start from one of these two Excel files, so the sheets and columns are already right.

get.text: What you get: scb-tgl-cf-bulk-upload-sample.xlsx, saved to your computer. It has a _Guide sheet and one sheet per kind of fragment with the right columns (red header = required) and an action dropdown. Each sheet has one grey SAMPLE row copied from the newest fragment of that kind, so you can see real values; it is never uploaded. No other existing content is in it.

What you get: a new, dated Excel file in the DAM reports folder, with every fragment in the folder, one row each, and its current values (offers with the latest end date first). Nothing in the fragments changes. A link to the file appears below when it is saved; download it from Assets and edit the rows you want to change or delete.

term.text: Why are the buttons greyed out?

text.text: Both files are built from the offer-listing folder, so the buttons work only once a folder named offer-listing is picked on the left. They grey out again if you pick another folder.

guide.text: The workbook opens on a _Guide sheet that explains every sheet and column.

sheets.text: One sheet per kind of fragment: merchant-venue, merchant-details, category, offer-card, offer-cta, offer-detail. Keep the sheet names; delete the sheets you don't need.

headers.text: Row 1 holds the field names; don't rename them. A red header means the field must be filled.

action.text: Column A is the action: pick CREATE, UPDATE or DELETE from the dropdown. Rows with an empty action, and the grey SAMPLE rows, are skipped.

slug.text: Column B is the slug column (offerSlug, merchantSlug, offerCategorySlug, offerCardSlug, offerCtaSlug, merchantVenueSlug): the fragment's name in its folder, e.g. summer-sale. Lowercase letters, digits, - or _ only. It is not saved in the fragment. A column called just slug (English Name) is a normal field.

multiValue.text: Several values or references in one cell: one per line (Alt+Enter).

limits.text: A workbook can have up to 5000 rows and be up to 10 MB.

start.text: Start from the sample sheet. Add your rows under the grey SAMPLE row.

slug.text: Slug column: a new name. If a fragment with that name already exists, the row fails.

id.text: Leave the ID empty; the next free number is filled in for you.

required.text: Fill every column with a red header. The others are optional.

references.text: References to other fragments: their full DAM path, e.g. /content/dam/aemcloudproject/cfs/offer-listing/cards/platinum.

start.text: Start from a report saved just now, so every cell holds the current value.

action.text: Action: UPDATE on the rows you change. Clear the action, or delete the row, for the rest.

slug.text: Don't change the slug: it is how the fragment is found. A fragment can't be renamed here.

blank.text: A blank cell clears that field (the ID is never cleared). The dry run lists the fields it would clear.

columns.text: To leave a field untouched on every row, delete its whole column.

required.text: Columns with a red header can't be emptied.

action.text: Action: DELETE and the slug. The other cells are ignored.

order.text: Deletes run after all creates and updates, offers first and merchant venues last.

warn.text: A fragment that other fragments or pages point to, or that is published, is kept and shown as Warn with the reason. Remove the references or unpublish it first.

missing.text: A slug that doesn't exist fails the row.

undo.text: A delete can't be undone. Save a report first if you might need the values again.

text.text: The Excel file you filled in. Upload it to the imports folder in Assets first (drag it onto the folder, or Create → Files), then pick it here. Uploading a changed copy over the same file is fine.

filePath.emptyText: Click the folder icon and pick your workbook in the imports folder
filePath.name: filePath

text.text: Checks every row and shows a Pass, Warn, Fail or Skip result for each one below. Nothing is changed. Works once an offer-listing folder and a workbook are picked.

Makes the changes and saves a report of the run in DAM. Nothing is published. It works only after a dry run of the same workbook and folder with no Fail rows (Warn is fine), and greys out again if you pick another workbook or folder. If the file is uploaded again after the dry run, run the dry run again.
